recap.text: Vrah knifes a note to Carl's saferoom door promising a slow death. Carl kicks a wheeled bomb named Just Wait Until Your Daddy Gets Home out the door, killing three mantids. This leaves Vrah as the only warrior daughter of Circe Took remaining. Edict explains that the Dark Hive is a private corporation selling loot to the Burrowers.

beats.headline: The Hive is hunting you
beats.text: A hunting party on the Hunting Grounds, and the message it sends Carl is a note knifed to the saferoom door and signed by Vrah: the Hive is hunting him, there will be nowhere to hide, and his death will not be quick.
beats.gist: Vrah knifes a note to the saferoom door stating the Dark Hive is hunting Carl.

beats.headline: Circe Took's daughters
beats.text: The Dark Hive's party in the Hunting Grounds is a family concern. A CrawlCon audience that knows it well counts eight mantids left on the floor: seven warriors, all daughters of Circe Took, Vrah among them, and one male who stays in Zockau trading with the other representatives. Circe chairs Carl's panel herself, carves a chunk out of the table beside him, and on her way out promises to hunt down whoever harms her other daughters. Carl calls after her that it will be him.
beats.gist: The Dark Hive hunting party consists of seven daughters of Circe Took and one male trader.

beats.headline: Seven warriors down to one
beats.text: Carl kicks a wheeled bomb the system has named Just Wait Until Your Daddy Gets Home out of the saferoom door and slams it. It kills the three remaining mantises, explosive protection and all. With the berserker and the sisters who went down with her, the seven warrior daughters are now one: Vrah, infected and airborne. The only other mantis on the floor is the male merchant holed up in Zockau, and Carl is already writing him a note offering protection in exchange for the gear.
beats.gist: Carl kicks a wheeled bomb named Just Wait Until Your Daddy Gets Home and kills three mantises.

beats.headline: A corporation that sells upward
beats.text: Edict explains the arrangement. The Dark Hive is a private corporation, and it sells everything it loots to the Burrowers, the royal family and government of the mantis system, who have paid in advance and expect delivery on the ninth floor. Edict's own family is of Deep Mind and employed by that government. Every mantis coupling must be registered ahead of time, with a trial and counseling for the male, and a government family may not couple with a for-profit one without a bond and a license.
beats.gist: Edict explains that the Dark Hive sells loot to the Burrowers on the ninth floor.

relations.note: The nebs and the mantids fought a war
